title: Paul and Silas begin the second missionary journey and meet Timothy
description: Paul and Barnabas disagree about taking John Mark along and part ways; Barnabas sails to Cyprus with Mark, while Paul chooses Silas. Paul travels through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches. He arrives at Derbe and Lystra, where he meets the disciple Timothy, who has a good testimony from the brothers in Lystra and Iconium. Paul takes him along on the journey after circumcising him because of the Jews in that area. The churches are strengthened in faith and grow in number day by day.

versions.title: Paul and Silas begin the second missionary journey and meet Timothy
versions.description: Paul and Barnabas disagree about taking John Mark along and go their separate ways. Paul chooses Silas as his travel companion and begins his second missionary journey through Syria and Cilicia. In Lystra they meet Timothy, who joins them on the rest of the journey.
versions.reason: [major] description: The description states that Timothy is met in Lystra, but the text mentions both Derbe and Lystra.
